tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri'i rten gzhi'i yi ge rnying ma'i don rnams dris lan gyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa log rtog 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje zhes bya bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza shrī mahā kā ye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus drag po'i sku/ /rab brjid chu 'dzin las 'ong dbyar skyes rnga/ /rab snyan ha ha'i bzhad sgras mi rtog bskyed/ /rab 'bar dbus gnas bstan srung gtso de rgyal/ /gang gi man ngag chu phran stong 'dus pa'i/ /sa skya'i bla chen chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /khyad par snyigs dus dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen spel ba'i mdzad 'phrin cha/ /gang la bsams kyang yid rab 'phrog mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i gnyen de gtsug na mdzes/ /gang de'i thugs sras grub pa'i dbang po dang / /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog grags pa'i mtshan/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa chen po ste/ /kho bo'i 'dren pa rnam gsum bsngags par 'os/ /sa skya'i rje btsun man ngag zab mo la/ /mkhas shing mkhas par grags pas brtags pa'i lan/ /cung zad spel la bdag blo spro bar gyur/ /'di la bstan srung tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol/ /ces mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir gangs can gyi skye dgu ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs mi'i sku gzugs can bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa gdon mi za ba sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas mdzad pa'i dpal sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rnying ma'i don rnams dris lan gyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa log rtog 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/

mkhas pa'i dbang po mchog gi dri ba'i gsung bkod pa/ de'i lan btab ste skal bzang dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams yid ches bskyed pa/ rgyu mtshan des na rang gi rjes 'jug rnams legs bshad 'di la gces par gzung bar gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ dus phyis byon pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cing / lhag par snyan brgyud kyi bdud rtsi spel ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang po tshar pa chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdams pa'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa po yod do cog la dri bar gsol ba'i nag po chen po'i chos skor gyi dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de yang dri ba mdzad pa po rang nyid kyis chos skyong gi chos skor rnams la mkhas par sbyangs pa/ gzhan gyis rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du dri ba'i yi ge de nyid las/ deng sang dpyod ldan mkhas pa mi brin zhing / /blun po rdzun bag mkhan dang zog po ni/ /'ur rgyang can dag kun gyis mchod cing bsngags/ /'di 'dra bstan pa nyams pas kun kyang blun/ /kho bos rje btsun kun dga' bzang po las/ /brgyud pa'i gser pod la sogs kun kyang thos/ /rgyud gsum smra ba pradz+nyā rat+na la/ /rdzong chung pa las brgyud pa zhib tu zhus/ /khyad par grub mchog dbang po kun spangs zhabs/ /ring du bsten cing gdung brgyud rim pa las/ /brgyud pa'i ma ti dh+wa dza'i snyan brgyud kyi/ /gdams pa ma lus bum pa gang byor thob/ /mdor na dam pa'i yongs 'dzin bdun la gtugs/ /tshul 'di'i phra rags chos la ring du sbyangs/ /dag dang ma dag yi ge mang du mthong / /mkhas dang mi mkhas sngags 'chang du mar bgros/ /'dir ni thun mong tsam du cung zad dris/ /zhib par phyi nang gsang gsum man ngag la/

/'dod tshul mang mod chos 'di zab pa dang / /chos skyong gnyan pas dri ba spobs ma gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de ltar rang gis chos skyong gi chos skor la mkhas par sbyangs kyang / 'dir dri ba rags rim rnams mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang / dris lan 'debs pa'i yul min rnams btang snyoms su bzhugs par gdams pa dang / dris lan 'debs 'os rnams kyi dri ba po'i kun slong rnam dag la dgongs nas myur du dris lan stsol bar bskul ba dang / dri ba'i yi ge 'di nyid kyi ming ston pa rnams rim pa bzhin du de nyid las/ de ltar dris pa'i dam pa khyed rnams la/ /bdag la med pa'i tshad ldan brgyud pa las/ /byung ba'i 'di skor yod na brda thongs shig /zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod nas len par spro/ /zhes dang / blun po rgyus med nor gyis dregs pa dang / /chen pos smras tshad gtam du song ba dang / /zog po ya med rtog ge'i dug chus myos/ /de rnams la ni dri min btang snyoms bzhugs/ /zhes dang / rang nyid mkhas par bsgrub pa'i grags 'dod dang / /gzhan la skyon 'dzin 'dod pa'i zol zog min/ /tshul 'di dad dang 'dun pas bskul ba yin/ /gsung bar 'os pa rnams kyis lan myur zhu/ /zhes dang / de ltar lhag bsam rab dkar 'dab gshog can/ /dges ldan snyan tshig mgrin pa'i rdza rnga sgrog /zab don dri ba'i ngang mo yid 'ong khyod/ /sngags 'chang mkhas pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtshor song / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i dri ba'i yi ge de nyid las/ gang la dri ba'i yul ngos bzung ba ni/ rgya chen sngags gzhung rgya mtsho'i mthar son cing / /zab don snyan brgyud nor bu'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /dpyod ldan gzur gnas rdo rje 'dzin dag la/ /dogs pa'i gnas 'ga' gsol gyi legs bshad stsol/ /ces pas dri yul ngos bzung nas/ dri ba dngos la mang du yod pa las/ 'dir mgon po'i gtor bzlog spyi dang / bye brag man ngag drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog 'di la tshad ldan gyi yi ge rnying ma la brten pa'i khungs rnam dag yod dam med ces dri ba la/

gtor bzlog ces bya ding sang rlung ltar grags/ /'di nyid tshad ldan yi ge gang la brten/ /de dang mthun pa'i phyag len yod lags sam/ /khams kyi phyogs na dgra chos zhes byar dar/ /dbus gtsang phyogs 'dir drug cu pa la sogs/ /rngam 'jigs spros pa shin tu che bar snang / /'di dag rnams la khungs thub ji ltar yod/ /ces dogs slong gi tshul gyis dri bar mdzad do/ /de rnams ni dri ba'i gsung bkod pa yin la/ ༈ /gnyis pa de'i lan btab pa la gsum ste/ yi ge rnying ma'i khungs bkod pa/ de da ltar gyi phyag len sbyar te bshad pa/ dogs pa'i gnas gzhan dpyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar gong du bstan pa'i dri ba'i tshig de dag las/ gtor bzlog ces bya ding sang rlung ltar grags/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum po 'di ni sa skya pa'i chos skyong gi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gtor bzlog mdzad pa po thams cad la dris par snang bas so so nas lan 'debs mdzad par 'os pa la/ bdag kho nas 'dir 'bri bar ma nus la/ de bzhin du/ khams kyi phyogs na dgra chos zhes byar dar/ /zhes pa 'di'i lan yang byed pa po dag gis smra bar rigs pas na 'dir ni ma bris so/ /des na 'dir ched du bya ba 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen yab sras rnams kyi rjes su zhugs par khas 'che ba kho bo cag rnams kyis ni mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i phyag len 'di nyid tshad ldan gyi yi ge rnying ma'i khungs dang 'brel ba zhig ci nas kyang bsgrub dgos rgyur snang yang / rang re rjes 'jug rnams bza' chog tsam don du gnyer ba las/ gsung rab kyi rtog dpyod shin tu chung bar brten/ gong du bkod pa'i dri ba'i tshig de rnams la rang lugs kyi rjes 'jug phal cher ji snyam du yang mi sems par btang snyoms su bzhugs par gyur cing / la la ni khungs med par ma 'dod cing /

rang gis kyang ma rnyed pas dri ba mdzad pa por skur 'debs par brtson par gyur la/ mkhas rlom kha cig ni mgon po 'di la gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'i tshul bshad pas/ man ngag 'di yang 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i rgyas bkab par 'dod pa sogs long ba 'khar 'dzugs kyi rnam thar skyong ba las rgyu mtshan yod par ma mthong nas/ kho bo cag gi bsam pa mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa 'di'i khungs rnam dag cig rnyed na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dang 'dod kyi dad pa chen po'i ngang nas rang lo nyer gcig lon pa me mo sbrul gyi lo dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal ga la ba der chos skyong skor gyi yig cha mang po la blta rtog bgyis skabs mgon po'i man ngag dpe rnying ma grab cig bzhugs pa'i glegs bam zhig gi khrod na shog bu gser mdangs can la yi ge lcags snyug gis bris pa'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gi yig chung zhig 'dug pa la bltas pas/ mgon pod me 'bar ma sogs na bzhugs pa'i shog dril drug gi nang tshan de yang ma yin zhing / de las gzhan pa'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gzhan du'ang mi 'dug pas/ slar zhib tu dpyad cing brtag pas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri'i rten gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rnying ma rje btsun gong ma'am/ dam pa kun dga' grags sogs kyis mdzad pa'i khungs thub cig dgos rgyur 'dug pa las/ kho bos rnyed pa'i yi ge 'di ni dam pas mdzad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i yig chung yin par snang bas/ des na sa lo chen po'i gsung rab kyi rten gzhi 'di kho na yin pa'i nges shes khyad par can rnyed de mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i yi ge rnying ma'i khungs tshad ldan 'di lta bu rnyed pa ni bla ma dang chos skyong gi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kho nar nges so snyam pa'i dad pa bcos min rang dbang med par skyes shing /

yid dga' bde tshad las 'das pa'i rab dga'i sa thob ltar gyur pa lags so/ /de lta bu'i yi ge rnying ma ngo mtshar can de nyid kyi khungs bstan par bya ba'i phyir man ngag gi yi ge de nyid bkod par bya'o/ /de yang yi ge de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag lag len/ brten gtor dang rgyun gtor bsngo/ bstod pa dang bzlas pa dang bskul rnams bya/ ma nyes pa'i dpang btsugs dang / nyes pa khos byas bsgrags pa rnams byas nas/ mdun du lcags snod du gtor ma gru gsum pa sha khrag til/ la du/ la phug 'bras chan/ sgog pa sogs kyis brgyan pa drug cu dang / ling ga drug cu lhan cig tu bzhag la/ de dag ṇ-i las dgra bgegs su bskyed/ dgug gzhug bya ba nas bsgral ba'i bar yi ge rnying pa'i dkyus na yod/ rtsa sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa drug cus btab/ mthar 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyis kyang btab na legs gsungs/ yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ 'phrin las gzhol/ zhag bdun gyi bar thun bzhir bcad la byas pas rtags 'byung ba nyams myong yod do/ /de nas sngar brten gtor dang rgyun gtor la ling ga bris pa bcug na de gnyis la drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ thal ba mnan pa bya/ ma bcug na mi dgos/ gtor ma rnams nam phyed dam/ nyi phyed dgra phyogs su 'phang / pho nya bskul/ gos nag brdab rjes bsrung ba bya'o/ /'di ni dam pa'i man ngag ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bla ma'i phyir du ma gtogs pa/ /zang zing ngo dgar ma spel cig /dam pa kun dgas man ngag snyan brgyud yi ger bris pa la/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la bzod par gsol lo/ /sa ma ya/ ྀatsha: zhes pa de rnams ni yi ge rnying ma'i khungs bkod pa yin la/ gnyis pa de dang da ltar gyi phyag len sbyar te bshad pa ni/ yi ge rnying ma de nyid las/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri gnyis mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis bshad par bya ste/

de yang yi ge rnying ma las/ nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni mchod par brjod pa'i tshig yin la/ de ltar mchod par brjod nas man ngag dngos bshad pa la/ 'di'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gi lag len zhes pas spyir bstan nas/ sbyor ba mchod gtor sogs bshom tshul rnams bye brag tu ston pa la/ yi ge rnying ma las/ mdun du lcags snod du gtor ma gru gsum pa sha khrag til/ la du/ la phug 'bras chan/ sgog pa sogs kyis brgyan pa drug cu dang / ling ga drug cu lhan cig tu bzhag la/ zhes gsungs pa de dag gi don rnams rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis lag len du ston pa la/ drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri las/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la dpal gur gyi mgon po'i bka' babs rnam pa bzhi byung pa las/ thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa la/ bsnyen pa/ bsgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum las/ dang po gnyis tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pa'i gang zag gis dgra bgegs tshar bcad pa'i las la shin tu zab pa'i shog dril drug gi nang tshan gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag lag tu blangs pa'i tshul mtha' yas kyang / 'dir drug cu pa'i tshul yi ge rnying ma rnams las gsal bar mi 'byung la/ blo dman rnams kyi don du lag len gyi khrig chags bstan na/ sbyor ba mchod gtor bsham pa/ dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i tshul/ rjes bskul dang gtor ma 'phang pa'i tshul bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad btab la/ chos 'byung nag po me ris dang bcas pa'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs drug sngon po'i lte ba dang / rtsibs rnams la lha brgyad kyi tshom bu bkod pa'i khar man dzi'i steng du lcags kyi snod che bar zan leb gru gsum che chung gsum brtsegs kyi steng du gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig bzhag

'og bang rim rnams la bshos bu gru gsum chung ba drug cu rtsa gsum lag len bang rim 'og ma la phyogs re rer bcu gcig re sum cu so drug bang rim bar ma la phyogs rer brgyad de nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ bang rim steng ma'i zur rnams su re re ste gsum bzhag bran bdud ma gtogs gzhan rnams khrag gi byug go /ltar bkod/ gtor ma zur gsum gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dpal 'bar btsugs pa bzhag lho phyogs kyi chos 'byung gi rtse mor pu tra'i gtor ma zur gsum dang / bran bdud yab yum gyi bshos bu nag po che chung gnyis bsham/ de dag gi mtha' skor du khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sogs drag po'i mchod pa g.yon skor du 'khod/ de'i byang du gtor teb lnga tshar gnyis mtheb kyu dang / ling ga bshom pa'i snod bya/ snod che ba gnyis kyi nang du mtheb kyu drug cu rtsa bzhi sha dmar pos brgyan pa dang / ling ga drug cu rtsa bzhi bcos la dbugs dang dri ma ma shor bar bya/ gtor ma sbyong ba'i khrag dang / chang phud kyang g.yas g.yon du bsham/ mthar bshal chu gtong ba'i snod ji ltar rigs pa chu gtsang dang bcas pa/ gzhan stegs ji ltar 'os pa la yi dam chos skyong gi mchod gtor gang dgos dang / thun gtor zur gsum pa bzhi yang bsham/ slob dpon kha lhor bstan pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod rnams gri lcags kyi gri gug dar nag btags pa/ dang / gzhan yang rnga / sil snyan/ dung / gu gul/ gser skyems sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'dus byas la/ zhes gsungs pa de rnams kyis ni sbyor ba/ mchod gtor bshom tshul sogs bstan zin pa yin la/ 'o na yi ge rnying mar gtor ma dang ling ga drug cu bya bar bshad cing / yi ge gsar mar de las grangs mang bar byed pa bshad pa mi 'gal lam zhe na ma yin te/ yi ge rnying mar drug cu las nyung ba mi rung ba dmigs bsal gyis bstan pas na/

dper na gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa'i grangs bzhin te/ grangs lhag pa la ni skyon med cing / chad du mi rung ba la dgongs pa yin no/ /'o na yi ge rnying ma las pu tra dang / bran bdud la gtor ma zur du bya ba ma gsungs so snyam na/ de yang ma nges te/ yi ge rnying mar/ rten gtor dang rgyun gtor bsngo zhes pa'i tshig gis gtor ma drug cu po de las gzhan pa'i gtor ma gzhan yang bshom dgos par bstan cing / drag po mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las 'chol ba'i skabs 'dir/ las byed kyi pho nya'i gtso bo mthu rtsal can rnams la ched du gtad pa'i gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol bya ba ni/ las de myur du 'grub pa sogs kyi dgos byed khyad par can dang ldan pa'i yang dag pa'i man ngag tu shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gtor ma de rnams khrag sogs kyis dmar nag tu byugs pa dang / thod skam dang rgyu ma rlung gis bus pa'i lda ldi/ yungs kar gyi gang bu/ tshe dang skyer pa sogs kyis brgyan cing 'jigs 'jigs lta bur byas nas lcags kyi man dzi'i khar 'jog pa'i phyag len 'di rnams ni/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa dang gsung rgyun zin bris su byas pa'i tshad ldan gyi gsung rab rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa du ma las bshad cing / bla ma brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa sha stag yin pas na log rtog can rnams kyis skur 'debs mi bya ba bag yod brten pa shin tu gces so/ /de rnams kyis sbyor ba'i chos 'phros don dang bcas pa bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i tshul ni yi ge rnying ma las/ gtor ma dang ling ga drug cu bya ba rnams bshad pa'i rjes su/ de dag ṇ-i las dgra bgegs su bskyed/ ces 'byung ba'i tshig des ni dngos su ling ga rnams dgra bgegs su yid kyis bskyed cing bsam dgos pa bstan nas/ de'i shugs la ling ga dgra bgegs su bsam pa'i sngon du 'gro ba bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis nges par bsgom dgos par bstan pa yin zhing /

de dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par yang yi ge rnying ma 'dir cung zad mi gsal ba rnams bla ma gong ma'i yi ge rnying ma gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang bya dgos par ston pa la/ 'di nyid kyi yi ge rnying ma las/ dgug gzhug bya ba nas bsgral ba'i bar yi ge rnying pa'i dkyus na yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid kyi dngos bstan la dgug gzhug sogs bya bar bstan pa'i shugs la 'dir mi gsal ba'i cho ga gzhan rnams kyang yi ge rnying ma gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya dgos par bstan pa yin pas na de dag gi don lag len khrigs chags kyi sgo nas nyams su len pa la dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri nas 'byung ba ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ste bgegs bskrad pa/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom ste/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs shing kyai rdor bde mchog sogs la phul rjes/ mgon po'i gtor mgron bskyed pa'i skabs su/ mdun bskyed kyi chos 'byung 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i steng lha brgyad 'khor bcas bskyed bstim/ dam bzhag gtor 'bul bya ba/ de nas gdong bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ las mgon rnams la gtor ma phul rjes/ gong du bskyed pa'i chos 'byung gi lho zur du bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum bskyed bstim/ gtor 'bul bya ba/ de nas dkar bdud/ phur srung bcu gnyis/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma phul rjes yi ge brgya pa dang / de wa pi tsu nas bzung bzlas pa rnams sems gzhan du ma yengs pa dmigs pa la yid rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas smin rgyas su bya ba dang / skabs der las mkhan mo'i bod pa cha gnyis dang / pho'i bod pa de'i cha gcig bzla ba'i phyag len 'di ni pu tra ming sring gi sgrub thabs dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa sogs yi ge rnying ma rnams kyi nang nas 'byung ba ltar gyi dgongs pa ltar yin no/

/der rjes bshags pa byas la bskang rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ nag po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa/ las mgon/ dkar bdud sogs chos skyong rnams kyi spyan 'dren rgyas pa byas rjes byon skyems dang bskangs gtor rnams phul la 'phrin las bcol/ de nas ling ga rnams la dgug gzhug lan gsum dang / lha dbye byas la bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dpang gzugs dang / 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /sogs dang / dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /sogs kyi mthar ling ga bsgral la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshig gis ling ro 'bul lo/ /de rnams yi ge rnying ma las mdor bstan gyi tshul gyis ston pa la/ rten gtor dang rgyun gtor bsngo/ zhes pa dang / bzlas pa dang / zhes pa dang / dgug gzhug bya ba nas bsgral ba'i bar yi ge rnying ma'i dkyus na yod do zhes dang / ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs dang / nyes pa khos byas bsgrags pa rnams byas nas zhes pa de rnams kyis bstan pa yin la/ 'dir bshad pa'i bram ze nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dpang gzugs 'di ni/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i skabs su phyag len la mdzad pa zhig ma byung bar snang yang / dus phyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mtshan ltas dang bstun nas gsar du 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin te/ gtor bzlog 'di nyid nyin gsum bsgrub pa'i phyag len sa lo chen po'i gsung bzhin sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyis mchan bur bkod pa gnang ba'i mjug na/ dpang gzugs 'di byas na legs pa'i ltas cung zad cig byung pa nas nged rang gis btsugs pa yin zhes 'byung ngo / /rgyu mtshan des na kho bos rnyed pa'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag gi dpe rnying 'di ni sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab kyi rten gzhir gyur pa'i yi ge rnying ma de nyid yin nges par rtogs pa yin te/ yi ge rnying ma dngos bstan las dpang gzugs bya bar gsungs pa la/ sa lo chen po'i skabs su de bzhin mdzad pa'i phyag len zhig ma byung yang /

dus phyis sngags 'chang chen pos gsar du 'dzugs pa gnang ba la legs pa'i ltas byung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa 'di ni/ man ngag gi yi ge rnying ma'i don rnams lhag chad med par thugs nyams su bzhes pa la mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis dgyes pa'i mtshan ma mngon sum du bstan pa gdon mi za ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dregs ldan log lta can rnams kyang tshul 'di la legs par soms la kho bo cag la skur pa gdab par mi bya zhing thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ de rnams ni 'phros don no/ /gzhung gi don la gong du bstan pa ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba'i tshig gis ling ro phul rjes/ de nas drug cu pa'i man ngag dngos gzhi nyid nyams su len pa la/ yi ge rnying ma las mdor bstan pa'i tshul du/ rtsa sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa drug cus btab/ mthar 'khor rnams kyi sngags kyis kyang btab na legs gsungs/ yang mchod bstod bsdus pa gcig bya/ 'phrin las gzhol/ zhes gsungs pa de rnams kyi don rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas nyams su len tshul bstan pa la/ dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri las/ der rjes byang gi gtor teb tshar gcig tu ling ga dang / mtheb kyu sha dang bcas pa bcug la khrag dang chang gis sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ shā sa na tshar lnga dang / lha mo la kā le de wi dang / zhal bzhi pa'i gtor sngags ring thung gang rung dang / las mgon la a li ka li ma dza dzaḥsogs/ bran bdud kyi gtor sngags rnams tshar re brjod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yam̐/ shap+da pra tits+tsha swāhā/ de nas nang mchod phul la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang /

bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad myur du tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'di la rol mo chems brdungs bya/ 'di'i bar la mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyis ling ga dang mtheb kyu sngar bshams pa rnams dbus kyi gtor ma che ba'i mtha' skor du blug slar yang gong bzhin bsham/ chang dang khrag gis sbyangs pa sogs nas 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar tshar bcu gsum byas pa'i tha ma la gtor teb gnyis su bshal chu blugs la phul rjes/ gtor teb rnams bshal la khrag gi rjes med par bya zhes gsungs pa de dag gis ni mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i snying po'i lag len rnams bstan zin nas/ de nas bdud rtsi lnga mchod dang / mgon po lcam dral/ gdong bzhi pa/ las mgon/ dkar bdud sogs kyi bskangs bshags bzlog bskul rnams dang / bstod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i glu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad/ smon lam/ de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /byas la/ tshogs 'khor yod na skabs der bya ba yin zhing / bsgrub pa zhag sbrel du byed na gtor ma 'phang ba'i nub ma yin pa'i nub snga ma rnams skabs 'dir spyi btab kyi thun gtor dbul la mjug chog bya ste/ de rnams yi ge rnying ma las mdor bstan gyi tshul gyis ston pa la/ bstod pa dang / zhes dang / bskul rnams bya/ zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyi bsgrub pa de nyid kyi yun tshad ji ltar bya ba ston pa la/ yi ge rnying ma las/ zhag bdun gyi bar thun bzhir bcad la byas pas rtags 'byung ba nyams myong yod do/ /zhes gsungs pas na zhag bdun du bsgrub pa'am/ yang rang nyid chig bsgrub lta bu bya ba yin na zla phyed dam/ zla ba gcig la sogs pa bsgrubs kyang rung ba ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched kyi gsung las thos shing /

phyag len du yang mdzad pa yin la/ 'on kyang ding sang nyin gsum ma dang / nyin gang bsgrub pa gtso bor mdzad pa ni dpon slob mang po lhan cig tu 'dus nas bsgrub pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgrub pa rdzogs nas/ gong du brten gtor dang rgyun gtor gnyis la ling ga bris pa bcug pa yod na de gnyis la skabs 'dir drag po'i sbyin sreg bya zhing / thal ba la mnan pa bya dgos pa yin la/ yang gong du ling ga bris pa ma bcug na sbyin sreg dang mnan pa sogs bya mi dgos pa la dgongs nas/ yi ge rnying ma las/ de nas sngar brten gtor dang rgyun gtor la ling ga bris la bcug na de gnyis la drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ thal ba mnan pa bya/ ma bcug na mi dgos zhes gsungs so/ /des na ling ga bri ba dang / de la sbyin sreg dang mnan pa bya ba 'di ni man ngag gi phyag len rgyas pa'i phyogs la byas kyang legs la/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas yi ge rnying mar yang 'dam kha can du gsungs pa bzhin/ sa lo chen po'i dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu grir yang 'di'i lag len gsal bar ma gsungs pa ni rjes 'jug rnams phyag len bde ba la dgongs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i tshul bshad zin nas/ gsum pa rjes bskul dang gtor ma 'phang ba'i tshul ni/ yi ge rnying ma las/ gtor ma rnams nam phyed dam/ nyi phyed dgra phyogs su 'phangs/ pho nya bskul/ gos nag brdab rjes srung ba bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de dag gi don rnams rgyas bshad kyi tshul gyis nyams su len tshul ston pa la/ dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri las/ rnal 'byor pa rnams langs la rnga brdungs shing / kye bos so nas/ mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod kyi bar dang / dpal ldan chos skyong mgon po khyod/ /sogs bka' bsgos nas gtor ma rnams bteg la/

phyi rol ji ltar 'os pa'i sar gong gi thun gtor rnams chang phud dang bcas pa khyer nas/ bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa'i pu tra'i bskang gso'i mjug bzhin mdzad/ mon bu pu tra gnas nas skyod/ /sogs kyis las mgon bskul/ spyi btab kyi thun gtor 'bul ba/ gson dang mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs dang / lha chen dpal 'bar gson cig 'dod khams gtso mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /sogs lha mo'i bzlog pa bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa dang / hūm̐ chos skyong stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur gson/ /sogs zhal dang / dam can mon bu pu tra khyod/ /sogs pu tra'i bskul gnyis bdag chen rgya dkar bas mdzad pa rnams phyag len la skabs 'dir mdzad/ sogs kyi bzlog pa/ de nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma sogs kyi bskul byed cing / phyi rol ji ltar rigs par mdzad/ zor gtor rnams 'gro phyogs su sngon la bran bdud/ de nas pu tra'i gtor ma dang / zor che ba rnams rim pas khyer la gtor ma brdeg sar slebs pa dang / gser skyems btang ba ni/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /zhes sogs kyis gser skyems rgyas par btang la/ de nas dpang gzugs dang / zor lam dbye ba/ pho nya bskul rnams byas la/ gtor ma rnams rim par 'phangs shing / phod kha'am/ chos gos kyi g.yab mo brdab/ dmod bcol drag tu byas la/ phyir mig mi blta ba nang du log nas bsgrub gtor rnams khang thog la sogs par gtang rag gi tshul du phul la/ srid zhi dpal 'byor dang / yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ mdun gyi chos 'byung du bskyed pa'i lha rnams ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na bdag la bsdu/ gzhan gshegs gsol brtan bzhugs skabs dang sbyar la/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs kyi bkra shis dang / rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya bar gsungs so/ /de dag gis ni yi ge rnying ma dang da ltar gyi phyag len sbyar te bshad pa bstan zin nas/

da ni skabs 'dir yi ge rnying ma'i mdzad byang smos par bya ste/ de yang man ngag zab mo yi ger bris pa 'di nyid snod min la gsang bar gdams shing / gang gis brtsams pa'i gang zag ngos bzung ba dang / mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod gsol dang bcas ston pa la/ 'di ni dam pa'i man ngag ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bla ma'i phyir du ma gtogs pa/ /zang zing ngo dgar ma spel cig /dam pa kun dgas man ngag snyan brgyud yi ger bris la nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la bzod par gsol lo/ /zhes pa 'di rnams kyis bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar yi ge rnying ma'i mdzad byang smos nas/ gsum pa dogs pa'i gnas gzhan dpyad pa ni/ yi ge rnying ma 'dir gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / sbyor ba mchod gtor bsham pa'i skabs su/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad btab la chos 'byung nag po me ris dang bcas pa'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs drug sngon po'i lte ba dang / rtsibs rnams la lha brgyad kyi tshom bu bkod par gsungs pa dang / chos 'byung gi rtse mo lhor bstan cing / lhor zur du bran bdud bskyed pa dang / sgrub pa po yang kha lhor blta ba dmigs bsal du gsungs pa 'di rnams tshad ldan gyi yi ge rnying ma gang las bshad pa yin zhe na/ de yang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi steng chos 'byung mthing nag dang / brag ri dmar nag gi dbus 'khor lo rtsibs drug gi steng du mgon po lha brgyad dang / chos 'byung gi lho zur du bran bdud bskyed par mdzad pa 'di rnams ni bla ma gong ma rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i lha brgyad sbags bsgrub sogs kyi yi ge rnying ma rnams su 'di lta bu'i tshul dag seb tshags su gsungs pa rnams brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i snyan brgyud la brten nas man ngag zab mo rnams khong sgrigs su mdzad pa yin te/ de dag gi khungs rnams 'dir ni yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/

shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis mgon pod me 'bar ma sogs kyi tshad ldan gyi yig cha rnams la blta bar gyis shig dang yang dag pa'i nges shes khyad par can rnyed par 'gyur ba ni chos nyid do/ /de bzhin du chos 'byung gi rtse mo dang / sgrub pa po'i kha lhor blta ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / chos skyong 'di nyid kyi las kyi tshogs rab 'byams bsgrub tshul la bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa rnams kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa'i shog dril drug ces bya ba'i gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs bsad pa/ gtor ma med par kha zas la brten nas dgra bgegs bsad pa/ dgra bgegs tshogs su bza' ba/ byad sha spag pa/ rmi ltas ngan pa bzlog pa/ gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang rbod gtong bzlog pa rnams su yod pa las/ de nyid kyi gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag nyams su len pa'i skabs su yang / rang nyid kha lhor blta zhing de'i mdun du chos 'byung gi rtse mo yang lhor bstan du bya bar bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bshom yig chen mo sogs su gsal bar gsungs pa dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi dngos slob hor dmag bzlog mkhan du grags pa'i 'od ldan dpal gyis mdzad pa'i lha brgyad sbags sgrub kyi yi ge las kyang / rang nyid kha lho phyogs su bltas te 'dug la sngon 'gro gtor ma btang zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang yi ge rnying ma rnams las de dang cha 'dra ba mang du gsungs pas na/ dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu grir gsungs pa'i chos 'byung gi rtse mo dang / sgrub pa po'i zhal gzigs tshul de nyid bla ma gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis dogs pa'i gnas gzhan dpyad pa bstan zin nas/ gsum pa rgyu mtshan des na rang gi rjes 'jug rnams legs bshad 'di la gces par gzung bar gdams pa ni/ 'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa yi rjes 'jug ces/ /ming tsam 'chang bas chog par 'dzin pa rnams/

/cher rlom dregs pa'i bdud kyis cher g.yengs nas/ /zab gnad 'di 'dra mthong ba'i skal bas dben/ /yang zab nag po chen po'i man ngag la/ /mkhas shing mkhas par grags pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs/ /kun kyang yid gnyis phyogs la cher 'phyang ba'i/ /gnas don gsal bar rtogs 'di ngo mtshar gnas/ /kho bo sngon bsags bsod nams mthu che bas/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes bzung zhing / /bka' srung rnams kyis bu gcig ltar bskyangs pa'i/ /rnam thar 'di la su zhig mtshar mi rtsi/ /'on kyang snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags/ /ji ltar byas kyang dmod tshig kho na smra/ /de phyir 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba brgyas/ /ma thul skye bo rnams la ci bya yod/ /mang thos blo gsal gzur gnas rnam dpyod ldan/ /kho bo'i rjes su 'jug pa'i skal bzang rnams/ /kun kyang tshur byon sdig pa'i grogs spongs la/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i ngag 'di nyon/ /nag po chen po'i man ngag zab mo'i khungs/ /kho bos gsar du rnyed pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /tshul 'di mkhas mang 'dus pa'i do ra ru/ /'jigs med spobs pa bskyed de sgrogs par gyis/ /dper na sngon med yid bzhin rin chen phreng / /rnyed na blo ldan su zhig rgyan mi byed/ /de phyir man ngag zab khungs rin chen 'di/ /skal bzang rnams kyis mgrin pa'i rgyan du longs/ /sa skya lo tsā'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings nas dgyes par 'dod rnams kyis/ /legs bshad 'di don 'dzin dang spel bar rigs/ /des na sa skya'i rjes 'brangs gzur gnas rnams/ /kho bos rnyed pa'i man ngag zab khungs 'di/ /ngo mtshar che ba las kyang ches che bar/ /rtogs par mdzod la kun gyis gces par bzungs/ /zhes gdams pa dang bcas pa de yan chad kyis gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag drug cu pa'i yi ge rnying ma'i don rnams dris lan gyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa ma lus pa bstan zin to//

//'dir smras pa/ 'jam dpal grub pa'i dpa' bo dbang po'i zhabs/ /rgyal sras zhi ba 'tsho nyid grags pa'i mtshan/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang mus pa rje/ /spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la 'dud/ /dam pa khyed rnams zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa/ /mngon du mdzad kyang tha mal skur bstan pas/ /bdag blo rmongs pas log lta ci bgyis pa/ /so sor bshags so nyes kun byang gyur cig /bla ma rang sems chos skyong dbyer med kyi/ /gnas lugs ngang la rgyun du gnas pa dang / /tha mal rtog pas bslad pa'i snang srid 'di/ /bstan srung dbang po'i rol par 'char bar shog /de la brten nas gzugs dang gzugs med kyi/ /stobs ldan dregs byed thams cad bran khol te/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ba'i mthu ldan shog /'di sbyar dge bas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho rab mnyes te/ /bdag cag dpon slob bu gcig ltar bskyangs nas/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i las tshogs gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa'i man ngag drug cu pa'i cho ga dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri'i rten gzhi yi ge rnying ma'i don rnams dris lan gyi sgo nas legs par bshad pa log rtog 'joms pa'i lha dbang rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam sprul rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad spro ba dang bsdud pa'i byed pa po rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa nag po chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/
